title: steps/memoryStore payload
description: Payload for the memoryStore hook. Fires before the agent writes to persistent memory.

memory_id.description: Identifier for the memory entry being written or updated. REQUIRED when memory_store.scope is user, tenant or global, so a later read in another session can be joined to this write. See Specification section 7.3.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL in the base schema; REQUIRED under provenance_producer: deterministic (ACS-Provenance). Validate against memory-store.acs-provenance.json when the profile is claimed. See Specification section 7.

lineage.description: Cross-session lineage the stored entry carries, so a read in a later session can recover the facts the write was made on. Set by deterministic framework code, never by the LLM. OPTIONAL in the base schema; REQUIRED under provenance_producer: deterministic (ACS-Provenance). See Specification section 7.3.

lineage_id.description: Identifier for this entry's lineage that survives the session, unlike provenance_id. Minted by the framework on each write and echoed by every memoryContextRetrieval result for the entry.

origin_session_id.description: The session that produced the content. The provenance_ids in content.provenance resolve in that session, so the pair (origin_session_id, provenance_id) addresses a node across sessions.

provenance_summary.description: The writing session's cumulative provenance summary at write time. A reading session starts from at least these origins for the entry. REQUIRED under ACS-Provenance.
